stories.headline: U.S. launches AI portal for federal services
stories.body:
The federal government launched America.gov, an AI-based interface for finding information and services across government websites.

Its chatbot searches official sources and provides citations with its responses. The site is free, carries no advertising and does not require an account. The government has not identified the AI model behind it.

stories.headline: Iran’s currency falls to a record low
stories.body:
Traders in Tehran exchanged more than 2.5 million Iranian rials for one U.S. dollar, marking a record low for the currency. The previously reported low was 2.2 million rials per dollar on September 2.

The decline comes as Iran contends with war, international sanctions and a U.S. naval blockade affecting its oil trade.

stories.headline: Court permits expedited third-country deportations
stories.body:
The Supreme Court temporarily lifted lower-court requirements that people facing deportation to countries other than their own be given an opportunity to object before removal.

The apparent 6-3 order lets the administration continue expedited third-country deportations while the justices review the policy. It does not decide whether the policy is lawful; arguments are scheduled for December.
